📖 How to use

  1. Enter your US shoe size (halves allowed).

  3. Read your UK, EU and foot-length equivalents.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do men's and women's US sizes relate?

Women's US sizes run 1.5 larger than men's for the same foot: a women's 9.5 ≈ a men's 8.

What is the UK to US difference?

UK sizes are 0.5 below US men's sizes: US 9 men ≈ UK 8.5.

Is foot length the most reliable measure?

Yes. Measure your foot in cm and match it — it is brand-independent, unlike numbered sizes.
